title: Decide row-level background-work indication for approval and error sessions
outcome: Decide whether session rows in approval or error need a visible and accessible background-work indication after row-label removal, preserving their primary status and Working counts.
acceptance: Record the product decision for approval/error sessions that own background work, including an accessible indication or the explicit decision to rely on existing counts and status.
If an indication is added, render coverage includes approval/error background cases and preserves their primary status plus Working/Completed classification.
